content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Allentown

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years of equivalent experience. Review PMI's official eligibility criteria to confirm you meet education and hours requirements before enrolling in training.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Our nationwide program delivers the required PMI contact hours on a schedule that fits working professionals in Allentown's healthcare, manufacturing, construction, and logistics sectors. Attend synchronously with active certified practitioners guiding you through core frameworks and real-world scenarios.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35 contact hours, submit your PMP application directly to PMI with your training documentation and project-experience verification. Pay PMI's exam fee at the time of application. Processing typically takes one to two weeks; PMI will confirm your eligibility status before you schedule your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor Q&A sessions—to build confidence. Schedule your exam at a Pearson VUE testing center in or near Allentown at a time that suits your readiness. The PMP is a rigorous, computer-delivered assessment; our support helps you focus on high-impact content areas.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Upon passing, you hold the PMP for three years. During this renewal cycle, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) by taking courses, attending conferences, or completing project-management activities. At renewal, submit your PDU record to PMI and pay the renewal fee to keep your credential active.
